mapper.insert: insert into learning_agent_memory (user_id, content, source, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{content}, #{source}, '0', sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select memory_id, user_id, content, source, status, create_time, update_time from learning_agent_memory where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' order by memory_id desc
select memory_id, user_id, content, source, status, create_time, update_time from learning_agent_memory where user_id = #{userId} and content = #{content} and status = '0' limit 1
mapper.update: update learning_agent_memory set content = #{content}, update_time = sysdate() where memory_id = #{memoryId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0'
update learning_agent_memory set status = '1', update_time = sysdate() where memory_id = #{memoryId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0'
